title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper… (CVE-2026-80502)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have an improper certificate validation vulnerability. This flaw allows an unauthenticated local attacker to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability is identified as CWE-295 and has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.8, indicating a medium severity level.
